objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed document with properties, content, versions, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding document type selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name composed by default from abbreviation, number per type and title.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document and used in workflow states.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment for reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned as author in document properties.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Person assigned additional personal change rights; no relevance within release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person assigned as reviewer in document properties.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person assigned as releaser in document properties, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate valid until; default value mentioned as 3 years for standard document types.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration of archive period definable for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects email notification when next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects workflow task distribution when next version is released.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in a multi-client system in which the document is visible or not.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification used to structure documents and define templates, validity and archive settings.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document type.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document naming.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration can be defined for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating new document objects for a document type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document template.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Passes through all statuses of the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachment is subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Has the same validity as the main document when released with validity extension.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user participating in roles, workflows, distribution and authorizations.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language used to determine visibility of released translated document versions.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned to document control, distribution or authorization attributes.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users/persons used for role assignment, authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Defined group used to assign read and change rights to documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the authorization group.

objs.name: system_role
objs.description: Implemented role providing users with functions according to their area of application.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the system role.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets.

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: System role whose users can only view approved objects.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: READER.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: System role whose users can be offered in author or co-author selection lists and create document types and change proposals.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: document_checker
objs.description: System role whose users can be offered in reviewer selection lists and create change proposals.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: System role whose users can be offered in releaser selection lists and create change proposals.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: System role that can translate released content into another language.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for document changes created and managed for a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate documents and process override/out-of-force declaration.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning user groups or persons for release information or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Distinction between distribution by e-mail and distribution for acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by persons or users of assigned user groups that they have taken note of a released document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Acknowledgements are listed depending on status.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created during revision, release, translation or reactivation.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Number of the document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the version such as editing, released or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version validity starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Validity end date of the version.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible in the corresponding login language once released.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the translated version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Translated version must be checked and released.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the client.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Master data object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be linked, e.g. IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained in document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained in document properties.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the report.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Selection parameters available for each report.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Selection criteria available for each report.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled based on distribution groups and used to list documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the dashboard.
